matrix_exit_criteria: Every row final disposition = MATERIALIZED_LOCKED, EXPLICIT_NO_DIRECT_ATTACHMENT, or SYSTEM_HANDOFF_LOCKED.
Every materialized row has explicit participants, interfaces, connection kind, evidence classification, placement/orientation resolver, parametric completion boundary, validation tolerance.
No topology obligation retains anonymous production counterpart.
No structural chain from column/eaves base through puzuo/frame/purlin/roof substrate ends at unexplained open node.
No historical detail silently invented to satisfy execution.

findings.title: 25/25 Master coverage is not whole-building connection coverage
findings.detail: Stage2-A contains 66 V008 object types. Beyond 28 MASTER_BOUND_PRODUCTION object types, 23 PARAMETRIC_SYSTEM_OR_COMPLETION and 7 SIMPLIFIED_PROXY object types require explicit attachment disposition when attached. Candidate V0.1 does not yet disposition these systematically.
findings.required_fix: Add V008-wide attachment-disposition coverage. Every non-Master production object must be classified ATTACHED_WITH_EXPLICIT_EDGE / NOT_ATTACHED / ORGANIZATIONAL_ONLY / REFERENCE_ONLY, with physical attachments materialized or queued.

findings.title: Many rows are aggregate topology tasks, not atomic connection edges
findings.detail: 27/39 rows use assembly roles, member sets or anonymous counterpart roles. These are valid investigation obligations but cannot themselves prove a complete component-to-component connection list.
findings.required_fix: Expand aggregate rows into atomic edge obligations after source extraction. Parent topology rows may remain as coverage groups, but lock criterion must be based on their complete child-edge inventory.

findings.title: Whole-building lower/upper/system handoffs are underrepresented
findings.detail: The matrix includes roof handoffs but does not yet systematically cover all Stage2-A objects requiring explicit attachment disposition, including base/foundation, wall/opening, roof-covering/ridge/ornament and other production systems where physically attached.
findings.required_fix: Create a V008 non-Master attachment-disposition table and add only evidence-supported physical handoffs as connection obligations.

review_patch_01_requirements: Add explicit V008-wide attachment disposition for all 66 object types.
Keep the 5 topology/assembly containers non-physical unless source proves otherwise.
Keep the 3 REFERENCE_ONLY_UNKNOWN rows non-production unless separately promoted.
For the 30 non-Master PARAMETRIC/SIMPLIFIED objects with REQUIRED_IF_ATTACHED policy, explicitly decide attached/not-attached and add connection obligations where attached.
Expand aggregate connection groups into atomic child edges before matrix lock.
Re-run graph closure: no unexplained open node from foundation/base through column-puzuo-frame-purlin-roof and attached envelope systems.
PR #49 remains HOLD; PR #50 remains Draft.
